messages:
dina: Quick announcement — running a targeted fallback drill this Sunday 03:00-04:30 UTC. Purpose: validate model-variant fallbacks + per-route rate reweighting logic. Expect short latency spikes as requests shift tiers.

oncall-bot: Maintenance event created: id fb-2026-04-drill-2330123456. Notifications will go out 30m and 5m before start.

raja: Which customers are in-scope? any Dedicated or private clusters excluded?

dina: Dedicated SLA customers are out. This only hits hosted best-effort routes and internal staging clusters. We will not touch production private deployments.

sre-lead: Short runbook: 1) At T0 start route weight change in eu-central-1 to push 15% traffic to fallback pool. 2) Observe routing logs for 10m, then increase to 30% for 20m. 3) Run kv cache priming beforehand. If error-rate >1% sustained for 3m -> rollback.

infra-eng: Priming script (run 20m prior):
`````
#!/bin/bash
PREFIXES=(\"/model/a\" \"/model/b\" /model/c)
for p in \"${PREFIXES[@]}\"; do
  curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_PREFETCH_TOKEN\" \\
    \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefetch?prefix=${p}\" &
done
wait
`````

raja: Can we scope to a small set of model routes first? I'd prefer to avoid broad fanout.

dina: Agreed. We'll run the first stage on routes: model-a-prod, model-b-qa, and workbench-internal only. If those look good, we can expand.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-04-06T02:30:00Z  30 minutes until fb-2026-04-drill-2330123456.

sre-lead: Who's on primary oncall?

dina: Primary: raja, Secondary: infra-eng. Incident commander: sre-lead.

infra-eng: I'll prepare a Grafana dashboard link and a short alert suppression list to avoid noisy pages. Will post in 10m.

raja: Added quick smoke: 25 concurrent requests across each route at T-5m, assert >=98% success and p95 < 350ms. If failure, hit rollback checklist.

dina: Thanks — last ask: owners of any pinned route variants, please ACK compatibility with the fallback variants by EOD today. I'll follow up with DMs for anything missing.

oncall-bot: Event started: fb-2026-04-drill-2330123456 at 2026-04-06T03:00:00Z (automated).

sre-lead: Posting the short status banner to #status-redwood 15m before start. Keep this thread for live notes only."
